How to play

Move: the thumbstick, or arrow keys / WASD.
Offense: tap the field to snap. On pass plays, tap a receiver's number to throw.
Defense: tap a player (or B) to pick your man. A is turbo; B switches during the play.
Grabbed with the ball? TAP TAP TAP as fast as you can to break the tackle.

Each side picks one of four plays. Guess their play right on defense and your guys blow it up.
